messages.content: You are a helpful AI assistant that solves tasks step by step.

Task Guide: Task: Task: Organic Compound Elucidation
Description
The characterization of the compound is: Return the SMILES string for the compound with the following characterization data: mp 31-32 °C; [alpha]23D -2.8 (c 0.350, CHCl3); IR (film) 3065, 3019, 2928, 2853, 1651, 1461, 1396, 1313, 1143, 1010, 739 cm-1; 1H NMR (CDCl3, 400 MHz) δ: 2.08 (s, 6H), 2.36 (s, 5H), 2.68 (s, 6H), 6.58 (s, 2H), 6.86 - 6.94 (m, 4H), 7.06 (ddd, J = 7.5, 6.2, 2.4 Hz, 2H), 7.15 (dq, J = 8.2, 0.7 Hz, 2H); 13C NMR (CDCl3, 101 MHz) δ: 19.9, 22.5, 32.6, 51.3, 125.4, 127.6, 129.3, 131.0, 135.0, 138.0, 170.8; HRMS (DI-ESI) m/z calcd. for C22H28N2O2 ([M+H]+) 353.2224; found 353.2229. The purity of the compound (99%) was determined by quantitative 1H NMR analysis using 1,1,2,2-tetrachloroethane as an internal standard. The ee (> 99%) was determined by HPLC analysis with an Agilent 1100 Series HPLC system equipped with a CHIRALPAK OD-H column (length 250 mm, I.D. 4.6 mm) (hexanes/2-propanol 90:10, 1.0 mL/min) with tr (major) = 6.3 min, tr (minor) = 7.7 min.
